# Introduction

Welcome to **Juanito's Card Vault**, a Shopify store specializing in Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) products. This product catalog demonstrates how products can be organized with clear information to help customers browse, compare, and purchase items more easily.

A product catalog is more than just a list of products. It provides customers with useful information such as pricing, descriptions, inventory, and images that help them make informed purchasing decisions.

::: callout-note
## Assignment Objective

This report demonstrates the development of a Shopify product catalog containing twelve Pokémon-themed products. It also explains the assortment strategy used in the store and discusses how these ideas could be applied to CPP Farm Store.
:::

> A well-organized product catalog helps customers compare products, understand their value, and make confident purchasing decisions.

# Assortment Strategy Reflection

The assortment for Juanito's Card Vault was created to appeal to Pokémon Trading Card Game collectors and players. The catalog includes a combination of raw single cards, graded collectible cards, booster packs, Elite Trainer Boxes, booster boxes, and accessories such as a card binder. Offering products at different price points gives customers more choices while keeping the overall theme focused on Pokémon collectibles. This assortment creates a complete shopping experience for both new collectors and experienced hobbyists.

# CPP Farm Store Application Reflection

Although my Shopify practice store focuses on Pokémon Trading Card Game products, the same product catalog principles can be applied to CPP Farm Store. Each product should have a clear title, informative description, accurate price, quality image, and current inventory information. Organizing products into categories makes it easier for customers to browse the store and compare products. A well-designed product catalog improves the shopping experience and helps customers make informed purchasing decisions.

# Key Features of My Product Catalog

The product catalog includes:

-   12 products
-   Clear product titles
-   Customer-friendly descriptions
-   Product pricing
-   Product images
-   Inventory tracking
-   Organized product categories
-   Shopify product management
